consequence.statement: The default datapath continues to be veth devices, so an operator who changes nothing is unaffected; netkit is an optional new mode available only on Linux kernel 6.8 or newer, and existing veth devices cannot be replaced in-place with netkit.
consequence.remediation: If interested in experimenting with netkit, follow the performance_tuning guide's instructions; switching an existing veth deployment requires recreating it rather than an in-place replacement.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.16 adds netkit as a new supported datapath mode for Linux kernels of version 6.8 or newer, while continuing to rely on veth devices by default, and an in-place replacement of veth with netkit is not possible.
